paper.title_en: Yrast-state lifetimes in <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>94</mn></mmultiscripts></math> at the transition between the isoscalar and isovector coupling regimes
paper.abstract_en: Half-lives of yrast excited states in <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>94</mn></mmultiscripts></math> were measured using isomeric decay spectroscopy. The experiment was performed at Radioactive Isotope Beam Factory, where <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>94</mn></mmultiscripts></math> ions were produced via in-flight fragmentation of a <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Xe</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>124</mn></mmultiscripts></math> beam impinging on a <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Be</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>9</mn></mmultiscripts></math> target. These ions were implanted into the GARi active stopper array, and isomeric delayed <math><mi>γ</mi></math> rays were detected with the IDATEN fast-timing array consisting of 48 <math><msub><mi>LaBr</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math>(Ce) detectors. The half-lives were determined using the generalized centroid difference method, yielding the <math><msub><mi>T</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> values of <math><mrow><mo>≤</mo><mn>15</mn></mrow></math> ps, 13(11) ps, <math><mrow><mo>≤</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow></math> ps, 693(72) ps, and <math><mrow><mo>≤</mo><mn>19</mn></mrow></math> ps for the <math><mrow><mo>(</mo><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><msubsup><mn>4</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><msubsup><mn>6</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><msubsup><mn>8</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup><mo>)</mo></mrow></math>, and <math><mrow><mo>(</mo><msubsup><mn>10</mn><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo></msubsup><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> states, respectively. Reduced transition probabilities were deduced from the measured half-lives and discussed in the context of shell-model calculations employing the JUN45 effective interaction. The results indicate that <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>94</mn></mmultiscripts></math>, with <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>Z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></math>, lies in a transitional regime between the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>Z</mi></mrow></math> isoscalar-pairing domain (<math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>92</mn></mmultiscripts></math>) and the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>50</mn></mrow></math> isovector-dominated region (<math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pd</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>96</mn></mmultiscripts></math>).
